doc: The fast-track lifecycle: a running app first, with as little paperwork as the quality gates allow. kcc-run and the auto skill use this table instead of auto-states.json when --fasttrack is set; the full lifecycle is untouched. Same placeholders and check grammar as auto-states.json. State ids are the ids of the matching full-lifecycle states (the dashboard and the event kinds depend on them); states that are not here do not exist in fast track (no ROI, CONFIRM, ARCH-GATE, BUDGET-*, WINDOWS). WRITE (one spec-writer per spec) and PLAN (one planner per spec) are per-spec `fanout` states: `kcc run` runs each of them for all specs at the same time in lanes (a spec's note and plan need only its own files, the architecture and the dialects), the bare kcc-run driver does them spec by spec. SPECS writes only the split (ROADMAP.md plus a stub note per spec).

states.name: IDEA
states.command: /idea-interrogator {input} --fasttrack {silent_assume} {depthlevel} (one pass: idea file, short Research.md with a '## Domain' line (common | specialised | novel), QuickRoadmap.md, SpecWriterStarter.md with at most the spec budget of epics, the first one a walking skeleton; collect open questions under '## Open questions' instead of asking)

states.name: BRIEFS
states.command: Run the four specialist interrogators for ideation/{IDEA} at the same time, one subagent each in one message, each --fasttrack {silent_assume} {depthlevel}: technical-interrogator (TechnicalDecisionBrief.md), infrastructure-planner (InfrastructureDecisionBrief.md), ux-ui-designer (UXDecisionBrief.md), security-analyst (SecurityDecisionBrief.md). Each writes its brief from the idea and the standards catalogue and lists at most 5 open questions under '## Open questions'; none of them asks the human.

states.name: ASK
states.command: Merge the '## Open questions' of the idea and the four briefs in ideation/{IDEA} (at most 5 per domain). {silent_assume} given: answer each from the standards catalogue, architecture styles, and the idea (never a CR-7 domain without a catalogue default; such a question stays open and is asked), and write ideation/{IDEA}/Assumptions.md as one table: question, assumed answer, rule followed, risk. Otherwise ask the human once (one question round, emit human-gate-triggered with gate_id and state ASK before, human-gate-decision after) and write ideation/{IDEA}/HumanAnswers.md. Then update the briefs with the answers.

states.name: ARCH
states.command: Run the architect for {IDEA} in the fast-track profile ({depthlevel}): write architecture/architecture.md with the C1 context and C2 container diagrams embedded, the main business flowcharts under architecture/flowcharts/, a '## Decisions' table (decision, library or package with its version range, standards-catalog or architecture-styles citation, status Accepted or Accepted (assumed)) instead of ADR files, '## Toolchain', and architecture/quality-gates.md (QG-PROD for deployables). Do not write architecture/adrs/, c4-component.md, dfds/ or sequences/, and run no critic loop: run `check-run-conformance -Scope architecture -RunProfile fasttrack` yourself once and fix what it reports.

states.name: SPECS
states.command: /spec-create ideation/{IDEA}/SpecWriterStarter.md --fasttrack --split-only {silent_assume} {depthlevel}: propose the split first (at most the spec budget, SPEC-001 a walking skeleton that runs end to end, every later spec a user-visible feature on it, explicit Depends on); {silent_assume} given: apply the budget, otherwise ask the human once to approve or change it (gate events around the question). Then write ONLY the split: ROADMAP.md (Execution Plan with Order, Spec, Delivery, Depends on, Lane) and, per spec, its folder with a stub note SPEC-NNN-slug.md (frontmatter id, title, status Draft, one-line Delivery, Depends on). No Backlog items, no arch.md, no plan.md, and do not write the specs in full: the WRITE state writes each spec afterwards, one writer per spec, and the PLAN state plans each one.

states.name: WRITE
states.command: /spec-create --spec {SPEC} --fasttrack {depthlevel}: write the full spec note, its Backlog items and arch.md for {SPEC} only, from its stub in ROADMAP.md and ideation/{IDEA}/SpecWriterStarter.md. Change no other spec and not ROADMAP.md.

states.name: IMPLEMENT
states.command: /spec-implement {SPEC} --wave {WAVE} --fasttrack {depthlevel} (one implementer subagent per item of the wave, all in one message, then check-wave-scope)

states.name: FIX
states.command: /spec-implement {SPEC} --bugs --fasttrack {depthlevel} (fix every open Bug item of this spec and every violation named below, test first, set each Bug to fixed; write only the files they name)

states.name: CLOSE
states.command: Close the fast-track run: write a short summary to coordination/run/closed.md (specs built, review verdicts, open bugs, how to run the result, and a gate table QG-QUALITY / QG-TRACE / QG-BUGS / QG-PROD as pass, deferred, or n/a with the reason; never call a deferred gate a pass), print it, and end with the next step `/spec-deploy SPEC-ID`. Never deploy. No traces, no token-guard; a memory-only /butler-remember --fasttrack only when settings run.butler is on.
